messages:
alex: Quick poll: who named the thermostat "ThermoGPT"? :joy:
toni: that was me. it gives very opinionated temperature completions.
sam: ThermoGPT's last reply was 'you look cold, deploy a sweater' and then raised the temp 3 degrees. emotional model behavior 😅
marie: we should give it an avatar and a release note. v0.1: avoids hallucinated heatwaves. v0.2: adds polite refusals to 5am experiments.
toni: release note draft: 'ThermoGPT: now with fewer rogue temperature samples and improved human comfort priors.' I'll add emojis. :thermometer:
ops-bot: note logged: 'thermostat_naming_and_release_notes' created. review in 72h. :spiral_calendar_pad:
alex: sticker idea: "I survived ThermoGPT v0.1" — who wants one? muffins for feedback.
sam: i'll take a sticker. and a muffin. also can we add a tiny system prompt on the unit: 'You are a kind thermostat. If asked to be creative, suggest music, not heat.'
marie: omg yes. put it on the device. make it small and slightly dramatic, like a zine.
ops-bot: poll created: ThermoGPT persona -> cozy/straightforward/sarcastic. cast your votes.
alex: voting cozy. i like my model with a blanket.
